title: The Interactive Red Furniture Mind Hack

vo.en: I will read your mind right now.

visual.description: A close up of a man's eyes staring intensely with digital data overlays.

vo.en: Quick, pick a single-digit number. Multiply it by two. Now add eight to the total.

visual.description: Abstract numbers flying past the camera in a dark digital space.

vo.en: Divide that by two. Subtract your original number. You are left with four, aren't you?

visual.description: A man writing mathematical equations quickly on a glass pane.

vo.en: That was just a warm-up. This next part is where it gets creepy. Don't blink.

visual.description: CCTV style footage of a dark hallway with flickering lights.

vo.en: Instantly visualize a basic piece of furniture. Now, give it a vivid, solid color. Keep it locked.

visual.description: A 3D blueprint animation of a room being constructed digitally.

vo.en: You are thinking of a red chair. I just hijacked your subconscious using semantic priming.

visual.description: A sleek red designer chair spinning slowly in a bright white studio.

vo.en: Subscribe for tomorrow's brain test and comment YES if this worked on you, which is exactly why...

visual.description: A close up of a man's thumb tapping a phone screen repeatedly.
